cards.name: Farad, the Purple Ohmen

effects.printed_clause: Special Summon this card from hand to a zone a Link Monster points to.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable hand summon procedure uses Duel.GetLinkedZone as the allowed zone mask.

official_references.matched_structure: Special Summon procedure restricted to a linked zone.

effects.printed_clause: On being Special Summoned to a linked zone: traverse pointing/co-linked Link Monsters with Current Counters until terminal Link Monsters point only to Main Monster Zones, move this card to one of those terminal zones, then Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your GY into one of those zones; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: The breadth-first traversal now records each discovered Link Monster depth, adds Current Counters to every visited Link Monster, derives destinations only from terminal frontier Link Monsters with no deeper co-linked successor, and moves/summons only into those pointed Main Monster Zones.

official_references.matched_structure: Official recursive Link-arrow traversal component; Voltester follows arrows through successive Link Monsters.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the previous destination mask included zones pointed to by interior traversal nodes, while the text limits movement to the zones reached when traversal terminates.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed terminal-zone traversal defect and corrected movement to use only the terminal BFS frontier.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
